subject: The secret workflow 99% of users miss
preview_text: Our top 1% don't just check picks. They do this one thing first. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For weeks, I thought our top users were just lucky. Or had some insider track. Then I saw how they actually use the app. It’s not about the AI picks. It’s about what they do BEFORE the AI even speaks.

They don't open the app and just look at the confidence scores. That's what everyone else does. The 1%? They go straight to the deep racecard analysis first. They scan the speed ratings and distance proficiency for every horse. They form their own gut hunch. THEN they compare it to the AI's prediction. This is the hack. You're not letting the AI think for you. You're using it to pressure-test your own read. It turns data into a dialogue. This is how you spot the value the crowd misses.

This is why the 'My Analysis' tab exists. It’s not just a static page. It’s your personal form guide. You input your initial lean based on the raw data—jockey, trainer, conditions. Then you see if the AI agrees, disagrees, or shows you a variable you totally overlooked. That moment of clash or confirmation is where real insight is born. It’s the workflow that separates punters from pros.

Open the app right now. Don't go to today's picks. Go to 'My Analysis' for any race. Write down your top two horses based on the form. Then reveal the AI's call. See the gap. That's where you learn. P.S. The users who do this daily are the ones who quietly message me screenshots of their winning slips. They started in the same place you are.
